Description
: Perfect for rock and mineral enthusiasts, this 6-piece lot showcases an attractive variety of raw mineral and gemstone specimens. The assortment includes a clear quartz point, a green mineral (possibly aventurine or calcite), an amethyst cluster, a layered brown rock, an orange and white specimen with orbs (potentially agate), and another clear quartz crystal with some inclusions. Each stone displays unique color, texture, and natural formation for fascinating variety. Great for collectors, educational use, or display, these pieces offer a hands-on look at geological beauty. Their raw nature highlights the intricate structures developed over time, making them versatile additions to any collection or ideal for studying mineralogy. Condition as shown: all pieces are in visible unpolished, natural state, with some rough edges, minor chips, and surface inclusions typical for natural, unprocessed rocks and minerals. No display stands or additional accessories are included
